message.content:
Yes—the standard historical account is that the Union Flag was first hoisted on **1 January 1900 at Lokoja**, marking the establishment of the **Protectorate of Northern Nigeria**, and it replaced the flag of the **Royal Niger Company**.

Some confusion may arise because the capital was later moved to **Zungeru in 1902**, and some sources may refer to events there. But the initial hoisting ceremony in 1900 is generally recorded as taking place at **Lokoja**, not Zungeru. If your source says otherwise, it may be referring to a later administrative change rather than the original proclamation.
